name: @pipeworx/mcp-serpapi

tools.name: serpapi_google_scholar
tools.description: Search Google Scholar for academic papers on `<topic>` — returns title, link, snippet, publication info, and citation count via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_scholar({ q: "graph neural networks", as_ylo: 2020, num: 10, _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

q.description: Search query / topic, e.g. "graph neural networks"

as_ylo.description: Optional start year (results published from this year onward), e.g. 2020

as_yhi.description: Optional end year (results published up to this year), e.g. 2024

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

tools.name: serpapi_google_maps
tools.description: Find local businesses on Google Maps for `<query>` — returns name, address, rating, reviews, phone, website, and GPS coordinates via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_maps({ q: "coffee shops", ll: "@40.7,-74.0,14z", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

q.description: Search query, e.g. "coffee shops", "plumbers near me"

ll.description: Optional GPS location + zoom anchor, e.g. "@40.7,-74.0,14z" (latitude,longitude,zoom)

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

tools.name: serpapi_google_trends
tools.description: Get Google Trends interest-over-time for `<terms>` — returns the requested trends block (interest over time, by region, or related queries) via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_trends({ q: "bitcoin,ethereum", date: "today 12-m", geo: "US", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

q.description: Up to 5 comma-separated terms to compare, e.g. "bitcoin,ethereum"

data_type.description: Trends block to return (default "TIMESERIES"). One of TIMESERIES, GEO_MAP, GEO_MAP_0, RELATED_QUERIES

geo.description: Optional two-letter geo code to scope the trend, e.g. "US", "GB"

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

tools.name: serpapi_google_jobs
tools.description: Search Google Jobs for `<query>` — returns title, company, location, source, posted date, schedule, description, and apply link via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_jobs({ q: "data engineer", location: "Austin, TX", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

q.description: Job search query, e.g. "data engineer", "barista part time"

location.description: Optional location, e.g. "Austin, TX", "London, United Kingdom"

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

tools.name: serpapi_google_news
tools.description: Search Google News for `<query>` — returns headline, source, link, date, and snippet via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_news({ q: "openai", gl: "us", hl: "en", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

q.description: News search query, e.g. "openai", "federal reserve rate"

hl.description: Optional two-letter UI language code, e.g. "en", "fr"

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

tools.name: serpapi_google_shopping
tools.description: Search Google Shopping for `<query>` — returns product title, price, source, rating, reviews, product ID, and link via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_shopping({ q: "wireless earbuds", gl: "us", hl: "en", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

q.description: Product search query, e.g. "wireless earbuds", "running shoes"

hl.description: Optional two-letter UI language code, e.g. "en", "fr"

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-serpapi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the serpapi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
